title: She said "ok." Your brain heard "I hate you" 😬 #shorts
description:
She replies "ok." and your whole evening is gone. A text has no tone, so your brain doesn't leave a blank. It fills it in… and a worried brain fills it in with the worst version. 😬 Send this to the friend who replies "k".

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/1nVuUlwU6Vk

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
